title: Auto-merge dependency PRs — delegated to the agent
action: merge Dependabot pull requests whose checks pass
outcome: dependency updates land without human review
trigger: when a Dependabot PR's required CI checks all report green
mainFlow: confirm the PR author is Dependabot and the label is dependencies
confirm every required check is green
comment on the merged PR linking to the CI run

failureModes.when: any required check is failing or pending
failureModes.policy: do nothing; re-evaluate on the next check event
comment 'needs rebase', add the blocked label, stop

failureModes.when: CI turns red on main within 5 minutes after merging
failureModes.policy: open an issue, revert the merge only if it was the sole new commit

acceptanceCriteria: PR merged and CI still green 5 minutes later
no human-authored PR is ever merged
no file outside the PR diff is touched
escalation: after 3 failed merge attempts, or if the PR touches workflows/ or auth code → stop and report in the repo's issues
